## §16.3 #10 resolution (ticket-owned)

`badly_off` threshold — adopted the spec's proposed rule verbatim: a profile is
`tested-badly-off` when **fewer than half of the measured features are within one band of
prediction, OR the blind check picked the prediction as the author's**. The flag lands on
`persona_profiles.calibration_status = 'tested-badly-off'` (written by the calibration
verdict fold at finalize); `deriveVoiceStatus` already maps it to state 7 with the
`rebuild` action. Recorded here per the ticket's in-body resolution instruction.

## Interpretations recorded

- **"two at ≥10" (§9.2 item 2):** read as *at least two included samples of ≥10 words* —
  the hold-out pool needs two readable pieces for the prediction-vs-real check. Enforced
  server-side on `POST /voices/:id/build{tier:full}` (422 `full_requires_4_samples` /
  `full_requires_2_readable`) alongside the ≥4-samples rule.
- **§9.3 "hold-out line in plain words":** rendered verbatim-direction on the Approve
  sample card ("one of your pieces is held back to test the profile — you won't see which
  until after calibration"); titles never name the hold-out pre-calibration.
- **`/app/voices`:** the committed route is `/voices` (PRB.10); the destination keeps that
  path — no route rename (the spec's `/app/voices` is the destination concept).

## Requirements (from the ticket)

1. `/voices` three-group destination (Your voices / House styles / Shared with you) — card
   anatomy name+byline, pill, sample count + source summary, projects using, last-built;
   never credits; §9.1 empty-state copy (REQ-PERSONA-1/19 surface).
2. Full Profile builds: creation-sheet radio live (locked under Free, "Available on
   Writer" — flag lands here, entitlement P1.16); name required; ≥1 description-or-sample;
   ≥4 samples (+two ≥10 w) for hold-out math; `profile_voice{tier:full}` six-phase run;
   snapshot + build note persist; derived artifacts `editMode:none` (405 on write).
3. Approve sample card: census counts, exclusions+reasons, hold-out line, estimate+cap,
   three knobs (sample cap, calibration on/off + warning, model tier); §6.4 wait/24 h.
4. Fetcher-only URL path: URL samples via `POST /voices/:id/samples/url` (no credentialed
   path); persona runs carry the real `UrlPolicy` (holdouts/calibratorAllow,
   serverFetchDisabled); hold-out leak audit voids calibration → `untested` + build-note flag.
5. Eight-state pill live: `BETA_VOICE_STATES` removed; one `deriveVoiceStatus` feeds all
   four surfaces; popover = four facts + concrete deltas + one verb.
6. Update voice scope routing (REQ-SPEC-27): synth / delta / calibrate / full /
   full_from_quick; sheet shows scope + estimate before consent; corpus notes per content
   hash (delta <30% of full).
7. Detail page five tabs (Overview/Description/Samples/Profile/Runs); Profile tab fixed
   section order, Calibration report first, editMode:none; corrections deep-link.
8. `profile_corrections` lifecycle: create → consumed by next refresh
   (`consumedByProfileId`, listed in build note, never re-applied).
9. Project adopt/fork soft lock: direct `PATCH /projects/:id/voice` rejected post-v1
   (409 + two hatches); fork → new project at `outlined` + copied outline + new voice;
   adopt → `persona_profile_snapshot_id` updated; optional `reseed_charter` with diff
   preview, never touches guidance lines, decision logged.
10. Composites/registers: `persona_members` render "Composed from A, B"; multi-register
    voices require a Register pick feeding `register` run input + `compositeVoiceMemberFiles`.
11. `packages/measure`: deterministic prose metrics (sentence-length distribution,
    punctuation rates incl. em-dash/1k, type-token ratio); output schema in contracts;
    feeds the calibration table + chat `measure` tool shape.
12. Hold-out reveal: identity hidden pre-calibration; `★ held out` badge + link after
    (REQ-INGEST-13 display half).
